Name: Stable Beginnings
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Adds a small quest with Marnie before you build a stable. Help her find a new home for a horse,

Playing with a new save is recommended for immersion purposes.

[color=#ea9999][size=5]Quest Trigger Condition
[/size][/color][spoiler]
[list]
[*]At Ranch
[*]Time: 9AM-5PM
[*] Player has earned at least 10,000 G
[*]No stable on the farm.
[/list][/spoiler]

[color=#ea9999][size=5]Configurable[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Quest Reward: You can adjust the quest reward in config.json. (No reward by default)
[/list]
